title: Login Page
purpose: This page helps you access your learning hub by signing in and landing on your profile.
key_actions: Confirm you’re on the login page (redirected from private pages).
Sign in and confirm you land on your profile.
Review the Hebrew error text if credentials are wrong.
After this, you can open Courses from your Profile.
tip: Pro tip: Use password visibility if available.
advanced_tip: Note your profile URL pattern for quick access.

title: My Profile
purpose: This page helps you manage your info and track progress in one place.
key_actions: Switch group tabs to view your courses.
Check progress and last activity for each area.
Edit your details if needed (owner only).
After this, you can open Courses to choose what’s next.
tip: Pro tip: Tabs reflect your LearnDash groups.
advanced_tip: Certificates may appear in a dedicated tab.

title: Courses Page
purpose: This page helps you decide what to learn next by browsing enrolled courses.
key_actions: Browse courses by group tabs.
View status ribbons: Start, In‑progress, or Completed.
Open a course card to continue.
After this, you can resume from the Course page.
tip: Pro tip: Switch grid/list to scan faster.

title: Course (Single View)
purpose: This page helps you resume learning and preview what remains in the course.
key_actions: Use Start/Continue to jump back in.
Check progress, last activity, and counts.
Review certificate availability if shown.
After this, you can open the next lesson from Contents.
tip: Pro tip: Preview video is optional.
advanced_tip: Counts help estimate time for your next session.

title: Lesson Page
purpose: This page helps you learn the material and move forward step by step.
key_actions: Review lesson content and related topics or quizzes.
Mark complete to unlock the next step.
Use Next; read the gating notice if blocked.
After this, you can check Grades to see your progress.
tip: Pro tip: Use the sidebar checklist to stay oriented.

title: Grades
purpose: This page helps you understand performance across all evaluated items.
key_actions: Scan the table for items and statuses.
Check the completed counter.
Review deadlines or pending items.
After this, revisit low‑score lessons or open Tickets if needed.
tip: Pro tip: Table labels adapt well on mobile.
advanced_tip: Refresh if you recently completed a lesson.

title: Tickets (פניות ואישורים)
purpose: This page helps you request help and track responses in one place.
key_actions: Create a ticket with sector, subject, title, and details.
Check your ticket history and status.
Open the details modal for content and attachments.
After this, return to lessons while you wait for updates.
tip: Pro tip: Clear titles get faster responses.
advanced_tip: Keep attachments small for smoother uploads.

title: Placement
purpose: This page helps you move your job search forward with resume updates and status notes.
key_actions: Upload or update your resume.
Check placement status and notes.
Explore related job‑prep courses.
After this, take a suggested prep course.
tip: Pro tip: Keep your resume current.
advanced_tip: Note the ‘last updated’ date after upload.

title: Reviews
purpose: This page helps you share quick feedback to improve your experience.
key_actions: Pick a satisfaction level and add comments.
Submit to send your feedback.
You’ll return to your profile after sending.
After this, continue learning or browse courses.
tip: Pro tip: Be specific—short notes help most.
advanced_tip: Keep examples concise for faster triage.

title: Technical Support Page
purpose: This page helps you get technical help quickly via the external form.
key_actions: Read the guidance on what to include.
Open the support form (new tab).
Use the fallback contact if the form is blocked.
After this, return to your page and resume learning.
tip: Pro tip: Include your email for faster replies.
advanced_tip: Keep the tab open until you submit.

title: Logout
purpose: This page helps you end your session safely and return to login.
key_actions: Click Logout in the header.
Confirm you return to the login page.
Try a private page to confirm you’re logged out.
After this, sign back in when you’re ready.
tip: Pro tip: Always log out on shared devices.
advanced_tip: Check re-login takes you back to your profile.
